go_to.title: Official taxi queue
go_to.where: Take the escalator down to level 1 and go out through Door 25 of T2 (some signs say 26). Ignore anyone offering a ride inside the terminal.

transfer.title: Trip.com transfer
transfer.where: Driver waits at arrivals with your name

go_to.title: Meet your driver
go_to.where: Arrivals hall, Exit 8 of T2. Look for a sign with your name; the driver waits up to 60 min after landing.

go_to.title: Metro Line 2 station
go_to.where: Follow the Metro / 地铁 signs from Arrivals. Buy a ticket at the machine with Alipay or cash.

didi.title: Ride-hailing · DiDi via Alipay
didi.where: P2 car park, follow 网约车 signs

go_to.title: Ride-hailing pickup point
go_to.where: Follow the Online Car-hailing / 网约车 signs into the P2 car park (level B1). Order only once you are at a numbered waiting point and tell the driver its number.

go_to.title: Maglev station
go_to.where: Level 2 of T2, follow the Maglev signs.
